description: Alpha Jacket Men's is a versatile hybrid GORE-TEX shell jacket designed for alpine climbing and hiking, built for extreme weather, shifting conditions, and varied terrain. Product Type: Men’s windproof shell jacket Material: GORE-TEX PRO Weight: 370g / 13.1 oz Hybrid construction uses GORE-TEX PRO Most Rugged in high-wear areas and ultralight GORE-TEX with Hadron® face fabric in low-wear zones. Helmet-compatible StormHood™ provides protection without impacting vision. Pit zippers add ventilation during high-output movement. Pair it with a men’s fleece jacket and men’s hiking pants for layering and weather protection on alpine days. Extreme weather, shifting conditions, varied terrain, motion and rest – these are alpine realities. The Alpha is a highly versatile hardshell designed to handle them. GORE-TEX PRO Most Rugged reinforces high-wear areas, while ultralight, highly abrasion-resistant GORE-TEX with Hadron® face fabric zones in low-wear areas shed grams and improve breathability. The helmet-compatible StormHood™ delivers protection without impacting vision, a RECCO® reflector can aid search and rescue, and pit zippers add ventilation.

Alpha SV Jacket Men's is a shell jacket designed for climbing and hiking, built as a durable GORE-TEX PRO outer layer for long-lasting storm protection in severe alpine conditions. The Storm Fortress. The iconic Alpha SV has long proven itself in the most severe alpine conditions. Breathable GORE-TEX PRO with Most Rugged Technology is paired with our most durable face fabric – made from 100% recycled materials – for incredibly long-lasting storm protection. The micro grid backer enhances resistance to abrasion and contamination, and the latest design updates make repair easier to extend your Alpha’s life. Featured for confidence in extreme conditions, the Alpha SV includes an embedded RECCO® reflector for improved searchability in emergency situations, our helmet-compatible StormHood™ adjusts for full coverage with maximum visibility, and articulated construction that frees you to move across mountain terrain.
